messages:
Sophia (Support): FYI customer can't redeem campaign credits during supposed free-trial.
Sophia (Support): Paste from customer email:
> We created a promo 'NEWYEAR50' to grant 50 credits on signup but when new users call /promotions/redeem we get `promo_invalid_or_inactive`. Started yesterday and should be live.
Sophia (Support): Repro steps from customer:
1) Create acct, 2) call redeem API, 3) API returns 400
Sophia (Support): Example curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promotions/redeem \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
 -d '{"code":"NEWYEAR50","account_id":"acct_9876"}'
```
Sophia (Support): Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{ "error": "promo_invalid_or_inactive", "code": "promo_inactive" }
```
Alex (CS): Can you paste the campaign id from Console and account id? I'll escalate.
Sophia (Support): campaign_id=camp_1189, account=acct_9876. Console link: https://console.redwood.ai/promotions/camp_1189
Eli (Eng): looking into logs for camp_1189. @maria heads-up.
Eli (Eng): quick check: redeem handler returning `promo_inactive` because campaign state is `scheduled` (not `active`).
Eli (Eng): Console shows start_date = `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z` but today's date `2025-11-15` — someone set the start date a year out.
Maria (Product): That's the migration default bug I mentioned in last sprint — bad default for campaigns created via API set start_date = +1y.
Jordan (Billing): Customer also says trial credits not added to balance — that's expected until promo redeems. Once active we should auto-apply.
Alex (CS): Was there also a per-account limit issue? Customer said only first redemption failed for all users.
Eli (Eng): Found second issue: `max_redemptions_per_account` is `0` in DB. Our logic treats `0` as "no redemptions allowed" (bug). Should treat `0` as unset/null.
Sophia (Support): Ugh — so two config mistakes: wrong start_date and limit=0.
Maria (Product): Root cause: internal API defaults. Fix plan: patch migration to set start_date to now for API-created unless specified, and change validation so `0` means unlimited.
Eli (Eng): Hotfix: I'll run a DB update to set start_date -> now for scheduled campaigns created in last 48h and set max_redemptions_per_account NULL where 0 for campaigns created via API. Running in 10m, will notify.
Promo-bot: Cron job: campaign-migration-check completed — 3 scheduled campaigns with future dates flagged.
Sophia (Support): Customer notified with workaround: create new campaign via Console or ask us to flip start_date. They asked for immediate grant for existing signups.
Jordan (Billing): For immediate grant we can issue ad-hoc credits to acct_9876 — I can do that once eng confirms hotfix.
Alex (CS): Action items:
- @Eli run hotfix (ETA 30m)
- @Jordan provision ad-hoc credits if customer needs immediate fix
- @Maria follow up with product doc update + migration rollback PR
- Sophia keep customer updated
Sophia (Support): I'll update thread with eng timestamp and customer reply.
Eli (Eng): Hotfix complete — updated 3 campaigns (camp_1189 included). start_date set to `2025-11-15T15:12:00Z`. max_redemptions_per_account changed NULL.
Eli (Eng): Postfix test: redeem call now returns 200 and grants credits.
Sophia (Support): Customer confirms redeem success: `200 { "granted_credits": 50 }` :tada: 
Maria (Product): I'll add a migration guard and create a canary to prevent future misdefaults.
Alex (CS): Nice work :thumbsup: Closing once Jordan confirms credits if needed.
Jordan (Billing): No ad-hoc credits needed — customers redeemed successfully. Marking resolved.
Sophia (Support): Closing with customer note and KB entry created: KB-2025-11-promo-misconfig
